title: Knowledge Base
switchDesc: Collect project documents (md/word/pdf and any text type) into a local knowledge base organized by folders and tags. When enabled with entries, new sessions get kb_* retrieval and organizing tools — the AI can search your knowledge base and reorganize it on request — and the companion skill is installed into the ZCode skills directory. Zero injection when the library is empty.
onHint: New sessions will include knowledge base retrieval/organizing tools and the companion skill
offHint: Sessions no longer get knowledge base tools, and the companion skill is removed (running sessions unaffected)
noteRedline: The knowledge base uses plugin-private storage (~/.zcgui/knowledge/) and never touches session data
snapshotDesc: Snapshot data (text cache, git-restore copies) grows with your library and can move to another drive to free up C:; entry metadata stays fixed at ~/.zcgui/knowledge/
reindexDesc: Clears the text cache and re-extracts everything; for repairing corrupted caches or parse errors, not needed in daily use
